about.lead: Three years building software that actually reaches production. Mobile apps with Flutter, web apps with Next.js, and the work of tying them together.
about.p1: I'm from Honduras. Trained as a Systems Engineer, working as a Full-Stack Developer. I build mobile apps with Flutter and web apps with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Before I ship anything, I write tests with Cypress and Playwright — I'd rather catch problems before the user does.
about.p2: I studied Systems Engineering at José Cecilio del Valle University and hold certifications in Full-Stack Development and Computer Science. Day-to-day, I work with Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini: they help me move faster, but the architecture calls are mine.

prizio.tagline: Price comparison for Honduran supermarkets · the first Flutter app in the country built for daily shopping.
prizio.description: Cross-platform price comparison app. Scan barcodes, compare prices across chains, set alerts, and build smart shopping lists.
body: Three national supermarket chains dominate Honduran retail, and none of them publish standardized pricing. A single item · a 500g box of pasta, say · can vary by 30% between stores on any given day, and shoppers have no practical way to know in advance.

Prizio was built to close that gap. Scan a barcode in-store or search from home, and every price shows up on the same screen, updated by a community of shoppers and merchant partners. Alerts are configurable, and smart lists route you to the cheapest basket across your preferred chains.
Shipped on iOS and Android. Firebase handles sync, Sentry catches crashes, and a Cypress-inspired Flutter integration suite covers the top 30 user journeys.

folium.tagline: Academic services platform with SEO-first content · 60 articles and a 26-service catalog at launch.
folium.short: Academic services platform with SEO-first content.
folium.description: Academic services platform with 60+ SEO-optimized blog articles, 26-service catalog, and MDX-powered content system.
body: Folium Labs provides thesis, research, and editorial services for university students across Latin America. The old funnel was a WhatsApp thread and a Linktree: no search presence, and no way for a prospective client to understand the services without writing in first.

I rebuilt the business on Next.js 16 with MDX-powered content, a typed service catalog, and Resend-backed contact flows. Sixty articles on thesis writing, APA, and research methodology went live at launch, each one editorially reviewed and indexed with its own schema.

Everything behind the scenes is typed end-to-end. Pricing, service catalog, and blog posts all live as static content that compiles at build time, with no CMS and no runtime database queries. Deploys are a git push.

printshop.tagline: E-commerce with admin dashboard and invoicing · custom-built for a Honduran print shop.
printshop.short: E-commerce with admin dashboard and invoicing.
printshop.description: E-commerce platform with admin dashboard, React-PDF invoicing, Zustand-powered state, and end-to-end inventory management.
body: PrintShop 504 is a Honduran print-and-sign shop with a growing roster of walk-in and B2B customers. Before the rebuild, orders were tracked on paper slips, invoices handwritten, and inventory reconciled monthly (and unreliably). Missed reorders were routine.

I designed and built a custom e-commerce platform with an admin dashboard, a React-PDF invoicing system, Zustand-powered state, and Supabase at the backend handling auth, orders, and a live inventory ledger. Customers place orders online; staff fulfill them from a single dashboard.
Built solo on Next.js with Supabase, React-PDF for invoices, and a Cypress suite guarding the checkout and admin flows.

arca.tagline: Five-language non-profit platform · blog, gallery, donations, and a full i18n stack.
arca.description: Non-profit website with blog, gallery, donation flow, and full localization across Spanish, English, French, Portuguese, and German.
body: El Arca Honduras is a non-profit serving children and families with disabilities. Their work reaches an international donor base, but the old site was Spanish-only and static: no gallery, no translations, and donations exiting through a single channel regardless of where the visitor came from.

I rebuilt it on Next.js with a full five-language stack (Spanish, English, French, Portuguese, German), a dynamic blog, a photo gallery, and a donation flow routing through the right regional processor.
Every piece of copy lives in typed translation files; no string ships without all five locales. Same stack I use for commercial work, same quality bar.

spotify.tagline: Generate playlists by mood, export to Spotify · live OAuth + Web API integration.
spotify.short: Generate playlists by mood, export to Spotify.
spotify.description: Search songs, generate playlists by mood, and export directly to your Spotify account. OAuth flow + live API integration.
body: Spotify's own UI exposes acoustic features · energy, danceability, valence, tempo · but only through its Web API. They're invisible to the listener.

This app surfaces those features as sliders. Set a mood, generate a playlist that matches, preview it, then push the whole thing straight to your Spotify account via OAuth. No credentials stored anywhere; the app talks directly to the Web API and to your account, with nothing in between.
I built it to understand OAuth from start to finish. Every call respects Spotify's rate limits, errors are handled explicitly, and any action can be undone without breaking the session.

pharmacy.tagline: Internal pharmacy operations system · running unchanged since 2023.
pharmacy.description: Internal pharmacy operations system · inventory, billing, user roles, auth, and email-based password recovery.
body: Hedman Garcia Pharmacy is a family-run operation with thousands of SKUs and several staff handling sales across two shifts. Before the rebuild, billing was on a legacy cash-register system, inventory was eyeballed, and cross-staff reconciliation required end-of-day spreadsheet work.

I built a custom internal platform end-to-end: role-based auth with email recovery (SendGrid), unified billing, live stock adjustments on every sale, and staff-level reporting. Built on PHP and MySQL · deliberately boring server-side tech that family staff could trust and operate on modest hardware.
My first production system. Still running, unchanged, since 2023.
